workflows.name: add-rules
workflows.description: Copy rules into the current project for customization

workflows.name: check-experiment
workflows.description: Poll or report an ML training run: in-flight status/metrics, or completed results with PASS/FAIL/WARN checks. Use after /run-experiment or before verifying.

workflows.description: List orphan Claude Code auto-memory directories for worktrees and prompt for cleanup

workflows.name: clean-work
workflows.description: Safely clean .ai-work/ after pipeline completion — state-aware, with --dry-run

workflows.name: co
workflows.description: Create a commit for staged (or all) changes

workflows.name: consult
workflows.description: Convene a discipline consultant to challenge a target artifact

workflows.name: cop
workflows.description: Create a commit and push to remote

workflows.name: create-simple-python-prj
workflows.description: Create a basic Python project with pixi or uv package manager

workflows.name: create-worktree
workflows.description: Create a new git worktree in .claude/worktrees/

workflows.name: dashboard
workflows.description: Launch the Praxion pipeline dashboard for the current project. Opens the dashboard in your browser on macOS; prints the URL to open manually on other platforms. Shows architecture, documentation, in-flight workshops, ADRs, sentinel reports, roadmap, and metrics. Requires the dashboard to be installed (part of the Praxion plugin). Delegates to praxion-dashboard for process management.

workflows.name: decisions
workflows.description: Disposition decision-health findings in batch — repairs first as grouped approvals, retirement candidates one at a time, never in bulk.

workflows.name: decontaminate-ids
workflows.description: Detect and remediate REQ/AC/step citations in the current project's source code

workflows.name: dispatch-reworks
workflows.description: Fan out /resume-rework into all rework worktrees from REWORK_MANIFEST.md. Default mode is background (--bg); pass --terminals for visible windows.

workflows.name: document-api
workflows.description: Scaffold best-in-class API documentation for a project's own API surface — detects language/protocol/surface, scaffolds the Diátaxis skeleton + Spectral ruleset + CI gate, idempotent (skip-or-merge, never clobbers authored content)

workflows.name: eval-praxion
workflows.description: Run out-of-band quality evaluation against Praxion pipeline artifacts (mechanical + LLM-as-judge). Opt-in, never hook-driven.

workflows.name: explore-project
workflows.description: Explore and understand an unfamiliar project's architecture, patterns, and workflow

workflows.name: full-security-scan
workflows.description: Run a full-project security audit against all security-critical paths

workflows.name: handoff
workflows.description: Compose HANDOFF.md at a pipeline boundary or a session's end so the next window inherits position, constraints and corrections.

workflows.name: landscape-refresh
workflows.description: Bootstrap or refresh the project's landscape watchlist — flag stale entries (>90 days) and optionally re-validate URLs
heading_outline: ### Bootstrap mode — file does not exist

workflows.name: manage-readme
workflows.description: Create or refine README.md files with precision-first technical writing style

workflows.name: merge-worktree
workflows.description: Merge a worktree branch back into current branch

workflows.name: praxion-complete-install
workflows.description: Reconfigure or recover a marketplace-installed Praxion setup — check its state, then hand you the exact command to run in your own terminal to symlink rules and CLI scripts (and remove leftover state from earlier Praxion versions, if any). Optional (auto-completes on first session).
heading_outline: ## When to use this vs. `./install.sh code`

workflows.name: praxion-complete-uninstall
workflows.description: Reverse /praxion-complete-install — check its state, then hand you the exact command to run in your own terminal to remove rule/script symlinks (and leftover state from earlier Praxion versions, if any). Plugin body is preserved.

workflows.name: project-coverage
workflows.description: Run the project's canonical coverage target and render a terminal summary using the test-coverage skill

workflows.name: project-metrics
workflows.description: Compute project complexity/health metrics (churn, complexity, coupling, hot-spots, trends) and write a timestamped report triple to .ai-state/

workflows.name: refresh-claude-blocks
workflows.description: Refresh this project's onboarded CLAUDE.md canonical blocks against the currently installed praxion plugin, with an interactive disposition loop for locally customized blocks

workflows.name: refresh-skill
workflows.description: Refresh version-sensitive sections of a skill against current upstream documentation

workflows.name: release
workflows.description: Cut a stable release by dispatching the Release CI workflow (bump + changelog + tag + GitHub release)

workflows.name: report-praxion-issue
workflows.description: File a Praxion-origin ecosystem-defect issue on the Praxion repo from a captured healing-sidecar candidate, with a human confirmation gate before every filing

workflows.name: report-upstream
workflows.description: File a well-formed bug report on an upstream open-source project

workflows.name: resume-pipeline
workflows.description: Reconcile a pipeline's WIP.md against ground truth (git + tests + the observations.jsonl WAL) and auto-recover truncated steps — auto-mark verified-complete work, auto-resume partial work, surface the ambiguous — leaving a full audit trail on every action.
heading_outline: ## Audit trail (five surfaces — recovery is never silent)

workflows.name: resume-rework
workflows.description: Dispatch the appropriate agent for a rework worktree. Reads VERIFIER_FINDINGS.md from the current worktree's .ai-work/ tree. Run inside a rework worktree created by the main agent from REWORK_MANIFEST.md.

workflows.name: review-interface
workflows.description: Run an interface design review on a file, PR, branch, or named surface

workflows.name: review-pr
workflows.description: Code review a pull request

workflows.name: roadmap
workflows.description: Produce a project-audited ROADMAP.md via a project-derived evaluation lens set — strengths, weaknesses, deprecations, phased improvements — through the roadmap-cartographer agent

workflows.name: run-experiment
workflows.description: Dispatch an ML training experiment to the configured backend (local, SkyPilot, RunPod, or Nebius), validate the compute budget, stream metrics, and write TRAINING_RESULTS.md.

workflows.name: scores
workflows.description: Read .ai-state/eval_ledger/EVAL_LOG.md and render a ranked leaderboard table of eval runs, with optional task filter and sort control.

workflows.name: sdd-coverage
workflows.description: Report spec-to-test and spec-to-code coverage for REQ IDs

workflows.name: skill-genesis-review
workflows.description: Disposition pending proposals from a skill-genesis report — batch multi-select; records approve/reject/refine/defer per proposal; surfaces delegation handoffs.

workflows.name: skill-genesis
workflows.description: Run skill-genesis as an on-demand autonomous learning harvest. Writes a timestamped report to .ai-state/skill_genesis_reports/. Disposition later via /skill-genesis-review.

workflows.description: Star the Praxion repo on GitHub

workflows.description: Run the tests a change needs, derived from layout, imports, path literals and the declared list

workflows.description: Judge tech-debt ledger candidates against the current project state and apply confirmed outcomes as dated stamps — repairs proposed per-row, discards judged against a confidence gate, unresolved rows escalated to the user rather than guessed.
